releases.notes:
### Fixed - `/inventorywizard` on its own now sorts your inventory like `/iwiz`; before, only `/inventorywizard ` worked. - **Default sort:** redstone parts (repeaters, comparators, pistons, hoppers, levers, buttons, doors, rails) and decorations (carpets, banners, candles, lanterns, flowers, heads) now get their own categories instead of being lumped in with other blocks. In the client mod, crops you can eat (carrots, potatoes, berries) now sort with food. - **Paper:** waxed copper blocks are no longer sorted as tools. - A settings file that can't be read (for example after a typo while editing it by hand) is now kept as `inventorywizard.json.bak` before the defaults replace it, so your settings aren't lost. ## Downloads Pick the jar for your Minecraft version and loader. From 26.1 one jar covers Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge and Forge; before that, NeoForge and Forge share a jar and Fabric/Quilt has its own. Fabric and Quilt also need [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api). ### Changed - Redesigned settings screen: options are grouped into Sorting, Feedback, Sorting Enabled For, Sort Partial Stacks In and Other sections on every Minecraft version, and each sort mode explains itself in its tooltip. - Options that do nothing with the current settings are greyed out: volume and pitch while the sort sound is off, and the partial stack options in Stack-based mode. ### Added - **Settings:** a magical new look: a shimmering two-tone title with twinkling sparkles, rotating tips, gold section headings, item icons on the buttons, and green/red ON/OFF values. - **Settings:** a live **sort preview** under Sorting Mode that sorts sample items with your settings and animates them into place when you change modes. From Minecraft 26.1 it appears once you're in a world, since items aren't available on the title screen. - **Settings:** a sound pitch slider and a **Preview Sound** button. - **Settings:** **Reset to Defaults** (with a confirmation; locked slots are kept), **Unlock All Slots**, and a shortcut to the key binds. - **Paper:** anonymous usage statistics through [bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/InventoryWizard/34984). Server owners can opt out by setting `enabled: false` in `plugins/bStats/config.yml`. ## Downloads Pick the jar for your Minecraft version and loader. From 26.1 one jar covers Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge and Forge; before that, NeoForge and Forge share a jar and Fabric/Quilt has its own.
